original.weights: F124-O original + FIT-trained F124-U source-backed receipts, unchanged

hypotheses.exact_credit: For i>=1 add gamma to per-candidate accumulated value iff previous cell carried raw16 equals next public edge src_bits; never use target, oracle or label
hypotheses.mismatch_penalty: For i>=1 subtract lambda from per-candidate accumulated value iff previous carried raw16 differs from public edge src_bits
hypotheses.combined: Add exact credit gamma and subtract mismatch penalty lambda to original per-candidate value BEFORE original priority sort; retain unchanged original priority, seven active and nine retained
hypotheses.fit_only: For each frozen original O and U separately and each hypothesis, maximize FIT pair accuracy with ZERO FIT negative false positives; tie lowest gamma+lambda, then gamma, lambda. No eligible proposal -> unqualified; default baseline 0,0
hypotheses.dev_success: Strictly improve frozen baseline correct pair count and yield zero DEV false positives while at most 16 original persistent cells. Otherwise retain negative, NEVER reselect on DEV.
